text: Snapshot idle_since and session_state since, fixed in claude-code-wrapper.
user_message event for every pasted prompt (user, peer, hook, restart, command).

Gaps fixed in claude-code-wrapper itself; every task updates README.md; targeted verify only; README notes the rebase onto origin/main before the PR (session claude-code-wrapper-58 develops it concurrently).

An onStart instance hook fires once per ccw process start, after the global mise install and before peer join, resume_on_start or any session create, so agent-orchestrator can install any-mcp per pod before claude spawns MCP servers; a blocking deny or an on_error deny failure exits non-zero (gap found at the agent-orchestrator gate: onCreate runs after claude starts, setup_commands run per created session only)
